newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks open little changed, light trade.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks open little changed, light trade.

text.p: The Australian share market edged just lower at the open on Thursday with traders adopting a cautious stance ahead of the holiday weekend.
Australian markets will be closed on Friday for ANZAC Day.
The All Ordinaries index lost 2.6 points to 2,469.7.
The flat start and light trade failed to surprise with few investors willing to take positions ahead of the holiday.

"People will be looking to go in square (to the weekend) as the U.S. has two more sessions before we reopen," said a Sydney broker. A single figure finish was tipped as the most likely prospect with little action seen.
Among the leaders, CRA was the best performed, up 13 cents to A$19.22 (US$14.99) after its dual listed sibling RTZ Plc gained ground in London trade. The rest were narrowly mixed.
Falls outnumbered rises by a ratio of about three to two, while about 41 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
